Release","draft":false,"immutable":false,"prerelease":false,"created_at":"2015-03-25T16:21:24Z","updated_at":"2019-01-17T15:31:55Z","published_at":"2019-01-17T14:33:18Z","assets":[],"tarball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/tarball/v4.1.6.RELEASE","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v4.1.6.RELEASE","body":"## :star: New Features

- TcpConnection should extend java.io.Closeable [SPR-12849] [#17447](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17447)
- Ignore null in HeadersBuilder#headers [SPR-12792] [#17389](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17389)
- RestTemplate logging for 404 status code [SPR-12760] [#17357](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17357)
- Support `@NumberFormat` as a meta-annotation [SPR-12743] [#17340](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17340)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Exception cache resolver shouldn't be mandatory [SPR-12850] [#17448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17448)
- CacheLoader is ignored as of Guava 11 [SPR-12842] [#17440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17440)
- ConcurrentModificationException in ConfigurationClassParser.processDeferredImportSelectors [SPR-12838] [#17436](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17436)
- There is no spring-beans.dtd file inside of the spring-beans-4.1.5.RELEASE jar [SPR-12836] [#17433](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17433)
- Thread contention in HandlerMethod due to unnecessary BeanFactory.getType call [SPR-12832] [#17429](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17429)
- DefaultManagedAwareThreadFactory's non-JNDI fallback leads to StackOverflowError [SPR-12830] [#17427](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17427)
- X-Forwarded-Proto with comma separated list causes incorrect scheme [SPR-12816] [#17413](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17413)
- X-Forwarded-Port with Comma Separated List Not Able to be Parsed in Spring 4.1.x [SPR-12813] [#17410](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17410)
- Not reusable input stream in ContentCachingRequestWrapper  [SPR-12810] [#17407](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17407)
- Exception not thrown by OnFailure() when using ListenableFutureCallback [SPR-12797] [#17394](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17394)
- StandardMultipartHttpServletRequest.StandardMultipartFile not serializable [SPR-12795] [#17392](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17392)
- Regression in 4.1: UnsatisfiedDependencyException because a prototype-scoped FactoryBean is unexpectedly instantiated by getTypeForFactoryBean() [SPR-12786] [#17383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17383)
- ObjectToOptionalConverter wraps a source Optional<?> to the new one [SPR-12785] [#17382](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17382)
- LoadTimeWeavingConfiguration should not rely on private field injection [SPR-12776] [#17374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17374)
- Regression in 4.1.5: UriComponentsBuilder.fromHttpRequest sets port to 80 i.s.o nothing/443 [SPR-12771] [#17368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17368)
- GroovyBeanDefinitionReader does not fully support XML config files [SPR-12769] [#17366](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17366)
- XML config isn't fully supported for web integration tests if Groovy is on the classpath [SPR-12768] [#17365](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17365)
- EncodedResource does not include charset in equals() implementation [SPR-12767] [#17364](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17364)
- ScriptUtils and ScriptStatementFailedException confuse lines and statements [SPR-12752] [#17349](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17349)
- Specified MVC resource at root level not considered "under location" [SPR-12747] [#17344](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17344)
- Regression in 4.1.5: Alternative `@Bean` declarations with same primary bean name do not work anymore [SPR-12744] [#17341](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17341)
- Deadlock publishing event while creating listener bean [SPR-12739] [#17336](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17336)
- MockMvc PrintResultHandler asserts before result is set [SPR-12735] [#17332](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17332)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Consider rewording ack modes on the listener container javadocs [SPR-12705] [#17302](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17302)

:star: New Features

- MessageHeaderAccessor.getContentType() should get deal with String value too, rather than rely only casting to MimeType [SPR-12730] [#17327](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17327)
- Add possibility to set supportedMimeTypes in MappingJackson2MessageConverter [SPR-12724] [#17321](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17321)
- Open up TestPropertySourceUtils for public consumption [SPR-12721] [#17318](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17318)
- Preserve ordering of inlined properties in `@TestPropertySource` [SPR-12710] [#17307](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17307)
- BeanWrapper should auto-grow arrays on indexed set attempt as well [SPR-12706] [#17303](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17303)
- Add same origin support to SockJS and WebSocket [SPR-12697] [#17294](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17294)
- Allow MBeanExporter's excludedBeans to be configured additively [SPR-12686] [#17285](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17285)
- Change SockJS default to allowing same origin only [SPR-12685] [#17284](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17284)
- Allow YamlProcessor subclasses to provide the Yaml instance that's used [SPR-12671] [#17270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17270)
- Support `@Configuration` as a meta-annotation in the TestContext framework [SPR-12659] [#17259](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17259)
- Use UUID.randomUUID() for session id's in SockJsClient [SPR-12658] [#17258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17258)
- Add the ability to turn off automatic derivation of Aliases for custom parsers. [SPR-12643] [#17244](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17244)
- Allow Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder configuration to override the well-known modules' configuration [SPR-12634] [#17235](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17235)
- ResourceUrlEncodingFilter fails when Thymeleaf and the "/**" resource pattern is used [SPR-12630] [#17231](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17231)
- Enable reuse of DefaultActiveProfilesResolver [SPR-12611] [#17212](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17212)
- Consider caching the compiled pattern in OperatorMatches [SPR-12610] [#17211](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17211)
- AbstractRequestLoggingFilter and CommonsRequestLoggingFilter log level checks [SPR-12609] [#17210](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17210)
- Don't use Exception for normal behavior in org.springframework.core.annotation.AnnotationUtils.getValue [SPR-12604] [#17205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17205)
- Support specifying TimeZone in Jackson2ObjectMapperFactoryBean [SPR-12594] [#17195](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17195)
- RestTemplate - support response mapping to entity with potentially empty response body. [SPR-8016] [#12671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12671)
- AbstractRequestLoggingFilter should log actual body even after consuming request parameters on Tomcat 6 [SPR-7913] [#12568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12568)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Stomp error when PongMessage is passed to StompSubProtocolHandler [SPR-12728] [#17325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17325)
- Unhandled websocket error when unsolicited pong frame with zero length payload received from IE11 [SPR-12727] [#17324](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17324)
- ServletUriComponentsBuilder#initFromRequest can cause NPE [SPR-12723] [#17320](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17320)
- WebSocketTransportHandler passes Collections.<String, Object>emptyMap() to HandshakeHandler [SPR-12716] [#17313](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17313)
- `@Scheduled` no longer works in case of multiple proxied target classes implementing the same interface [SPR-12709] [#17306](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17306)
- Conditions on an overriding bean method effectively get ignored [SPR-12694] [#17292](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17292)
- ConcurrentModificationException thrown while iterating over bean definition names in DefaultListableBeanFactory#getBeansWithAnnotation(Class<? extends Annotation> annotationType)  [SPR-12688] [#17286](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17286)
- ConcurrentModificationException in SimpleBrokerMessageHandler [SPR-12665] [#17264](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17264)
- AbstractSockJsService.checkAndAddCorsHeaders fails for same origin requests when setAllowedOrigins is set [SPR-12660] [#17260](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17260)
- ResourceUrlProvider does not keep resource handlers ordered [SPR-12647] [#17248](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17248)
- During startup scheduled tasks are driven earlier than before causing problems with Spring Batch [SPR-12641] [#17242](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17242)
- CssLinkResourceTransformer throws Exception on links that start with // [SPR-12632] [#17233](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17233)
- PathResourceResolver.isResourceUnderLocation does not handle relative paths correctly [SPR-12624] [#17225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17225)
- Netty4ClientHttpRequestFactory always allocates "maxRequestSize" bytes for each request [SPR-12623] [#17224](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17224)
- Exception with JSON serialization in ResponseBodyAdviceChain when debug logging is on [SPR-12616] [#17217](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17217)
- Handle exceptions properly in SpringJUnit4ClassRunner [SPR-12613] [#17214](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17214)
- Default value of <mvc:redirect-view-controller> context-relative attribute is not "true" [SPR-12607] [#17208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17208)
- ResourceUrlProvider should initialize only once [SPR-12592] [#17193](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17193)
- ObjectToOptionalConverter should use Optional.ofNullable(…) instead of Optional.of(…) [SPR-12589] [#17190](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17190)
- Regression in TransactionAspectSupport.determineTransactionManager(…) [SPR-12577] [#17178](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17178)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Documentation error in "SimpleJdbcInsert" section [SPR-12639] [#17240](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17240)

:star: New Features

- Spring's JMX support can rely on native MXBean detection on Java 6+ [SPR-12574] [#17175](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17175)
- Improve diagnostics when AnnotationJmxAttributeSource triggers an ArrayStoreException from Class.getAnnotation [SPR-12572] [#17173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17173)
- org.springframework.cache.aspectj.JCacheCacheAspect is missing from META-INF/aop.xml in spring-aspects [SPR-12571] [#17172](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17172)
- PayloadArgumentResolver enforces Validator unnecessarily [SPR-12567] [#17168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17168)
- MockMvcBuilders should populate ServletContextAttribute WebApplicationContext.ROOT_WEB_APPLICATION_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE to enable view technologies use WebApplicationContextUtils.getRequiredWebApplicationContext(…) [SPR-12553] [#17155](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17155)
- Configured RequestConfig in HttpClient gets overwritten by default [SPR-12540] [#17144](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17144)
- Better implementation of showSql for EclipseLinkJpaVendorAdapter [SPR-12528] [#17133](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17133)
- CacheAspectSupport 's generateKey method should not concatenate Strings [SPR-12527] [#17132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17132)
- Add DEBUG/INFO logging in AbstractBeanFactory.registerScope() [SPR-12519] [#17124](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17124)
- Allow sending of binary WebSocket messages in StompSubProtocolHandler [SPR-12475] [#17081](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17081)
- Improve Constructor Resolver Diagnostics [SPR-12543] [#16975](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16975)
- Upgrade HttpComponentsHttpInvokerRequestExecutor to require Apache HttpComponents 4.3 [SPR-11113] [#15739](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15739)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Wrong TransactionManager selected when mixing `@Transactional` with and w/o qualifier [SPR-12606] [#17207](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17207)
- Duplicated interceptors in HandlerExecutionChain after intermediate getInterceptors() call [SPR-12566] [#17167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17167)
- VerifyError for compiled SpEL expression with primitive/reference type mix when using == [SPR-12557] [#17159](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17159)
- AbstractApplicationEventMulticaster "lost" application listener [SPR-12545] [#17148](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17148)
- `@SessionAttributes` not populated when going directly to POST and redirecting while ignoreDefaultModelOnRedirect=true [SPR-12542] [#17146](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17146)
- `@Transactional` qualifier is ignored by TransactionAspectSupport if default transaction manager is set [SPR-12541] [#17145](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17145)
- Performance - hashCode method of AbstractFallbackTransactionAttributeSource.DefaultCacheKey doesn't take targetClass into account [SPR-12536] [#17141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17141)
- CollectionFactory should create empty EnumSets and EnumMaps [SPR-12533] [#17138](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17138)
- `@EnableMBeanExport` exposes scoped proxies and their targets [SPR-12529] [#17134](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17134)
- Prototype with changing bean class does not get populated with dependencies after type switch [SPR-12526] [#17131](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17131)
- Regression: SpEL expression with Arrays.asList and empty array [SPR-12522] [#17127](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17127)
- AnnotationTransactionAspect retains reference to JpaTransactionManager from closed context [SPR-12518] [#17123](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17123)
- HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory does not set connection request timeout on request config [SPR-12166] [#16780](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16780)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add TimeZone and ZoneId to list of supported method arguments [SPR-12575] [#17176](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17176)
- Update documentation after SPR-3542 [SPR-12570] [#17171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17171)
- Add note to reference material about difference between XML destroy-method and `@Bean` destroyMethod behavior [SPR-12534] [#17139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17139)
- I can use ';' and EOL for delimiter of base-package attribute(component scan) [SPR-12523] [#17128](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17128)
- Names of Maven Dependencies [SPR-12517] [#17122](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17122)

:star: New Features

- Concurrent registration/iteration in PropertySourcesPropertyResolver [SPR-12428] [#17034](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17034)

- Allow overriding InvocableHandlerMethod.invoke and/or ServletInvocableHandlerMethod.invokeAndHandle in subclasses [SPR-12484] [#17090](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17090)
- Consistent bridge method handling in annotation post-processors [SPR-12495] [#17101](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17101)
- Check the user for a SockJS request [SPR-12497] [#17103](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17103)
- CacheAspectSupport 's generateKey method should not concatenate Strings [SPR-12527] [#17132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17132)

- NPE in SelectedValueComparator with null bound value [SPR-12001] [#16617](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16617)
- StaxStreamXMLReader ignores significant whitespace [SPR-12000] [#16616](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16616)
- UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString may not parse correctly when there is no path [SPR-11970] [#16586](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16586)

- Incorrect documentation for AbstractAnnotationConfigDispatcherServletInitializer.getServletConfigClasses() [SPR-12028] [#16644](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16644)
- Documentation typo  [SPR-12020] [#16636](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16636)
- user destinations docs are missing the brokerPrefix [SPR-11992] [#16608](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16608)
- Remove outdated IDE, JIRA and Tomcat references [SPR-7521] [#12179](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12179)

:star: New Features

- Improve Reference Documentation about Spring JMS (infrastructure) [SPR-12073] [#16689](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16689)
- Make `@Payload` as ElementType.METHOD too [SPR-12071] [#16687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16687)
- Consider adding static notFound() builder method to ResponseEntity [SPR-12070] [#16686](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16686)
- JmsMessagingExceptionTranslator package tangle [SPR-12064] [#16680](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16680)
- Add more HttpHeaders constants for standard HTTP headers [SPR-12063] [#16679](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16679)
- Improve exception message: Default SmartContextLoaders do not support locations and `@Configuration` classes simultaneously [SPR-12060] [#16676](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16676)
- Shortcut method for building HEAD requests with MockMvcRequestBuilders [SPR-12055] [#16671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16671)
- Introduce `@TestPropertySource` support in the TestContext framework [SPR-12051] [#16667](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16667)
- String to Enum Interface conversion not working [SPR-12050] [#16666](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16666)
- Missing custom entity type filter in LocalSessionFactoryBean [SPR-12049] [#16665](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16665)
- Improve comment in RuntimeTestWalker [SPR-12044] [#16660](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16660)
- Document that MockHttpServletRequest does not comply with Servlet spec regarding Accept-Language header [SPR-12043] [#16659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16659)
- SpEL Compiler: Make OpModulus compilable  [SPR-12041] [#16657](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16657)
- JmsListener/ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor should use SmartInitializingSingleton instead of ContextRefreshedEvent [SPR-12039] [#16655](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16655)
- JmsMessagingTemplate should not throw JmsException directly [SPR-12038] [#16654](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16654)
- Update JmsMessagingTemplate to support MessageRequestReplyOperations [SPR-12037] [#16653](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16653)
- Enhance ResourceHandlerRegistration API for resource transformers/resolvers [SPR-11982] [#16598](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16598)
- Isolation support for JPA with Hibernate EntityManager 4 [SPR-11942] [#16559](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16559)
- Provide initial support for Undertow 1.1 [SPR-11914] [#16533](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16533)
- Support Jackson2 based XML serialization/deserialization [SPR-11785] [#16407](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16407)
- `@Configuration` imported via `@ImportResource` is not processed [SPR-11723] [#16345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16345)
- Introduce mechanism for automatic discovery of default TestExecutionListeners [SPR-11466] [#16092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16092)
- `@Configuration` imported via ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar is not processed as configuration [SPR-11430] [#16056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16056)
- Support for JSR-356 on WebLogic 12.1.3 [SPR-11293] [#15917](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15917)
- BeanFactory lacks method for getting bean by type with specified constructor arguments [SPR-11235] [#15860](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15860)
- Support Groovy scripts for bean definitions in the TestContext framework [SPR-11233] [#15858](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15858)
- Compatibility with GlassFish 4.1 and Tyrus 1.8 (WebSocket 1.1) [SPR-11094] [#15720](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15720)
- `@ComponentScan` does not allow for registering beans with lazy initialization [SPR-10459] [#15092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15092)
- Spel Implicit Map [SPR-9472] [#14107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14107)
- Hibernate4 version of SpringSessionContext.currentSession() does not create a session if TransactionSynchronizationManager does not contain one [SPR-9020] [#13659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13659)
- readOnly transaction doesn't work with JPA and Hibernate 4 [SPR-8959] [#13599](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13599)
- Introduce mechanism for registering default TELs if a custom TEL is registered via `@TestExecutionListeners` [SPR-8854] [#13496](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13496)
- UrlBasedViewResolver should implement setExposedContextBeanNames (not InternalResourceViewResolver) [SPR-8064] [#12719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12719)
- Passing lookup-method arguments to created bean constructor [SPR-7431] [#12089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12089)
- Spring REST `@MVC`: Add support for google Protocol Buffers resource representation format [SPR-5807] [#10477](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10477)
- `@LookupMethod` annotation for use with component scanning [SPR-5192] [#9865](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9865)
- Binding in Velocity templates using EL accessors ([, ]) for collections produces non xhtml strict compliant output [SPR-5172] [#9845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9845)
- HibernateJpaDialect does not support setting a specific isolation level per transaction [SPR-5012] [#9687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9687)
- How to implement Pessimistic Locking with JPA [SPR-3812] [#8492](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8492)
- Implement synchronous request / response logic in JmsTemplate [SPR-3332] [#8017](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8017)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- SpEL Compiler: NPE on Indexer compilation, when is used map accessor [SPR-12045] [#16661](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16661)
- SpEL Compiler produces incompatible code with method generic returns [SPR-12040] [#16656](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16656)
- SockJsClient doesn't propagate "subProtocols" and "extensions" to the handshake request [SPR-12030] [#16646](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16646)
- NPE in DefaultListableBeanFactory#getPriority [SPR-12024] [#16640](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16640)
- Restore method signature for ViewControllerRegistration.setViewName [SPR-12016] [#16632](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16632)
- NPE in Elvis Expression (ExitTypeDescriptor null) [SPR-12014] [#16630](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16630)
- ThymeleafViewResolver not used by Spring 4.1 resulting in "circular view path" error [SPR-12013] [#16629](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16629)
- Spring 4.1 schema issues [SPR-12011] [#16627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16627)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Update references to RFC 2616 [SPR-12067] [#16683](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16683)
- Improve documentation for using "." vs "/" as separators with STOMP/WebSocket messaging [SPR-12007] [#16623](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16623)
- Add documentation for Java SockJS client  [SPR-12006] [#16622](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16622)
- Enrich Spring reference documentation (Websocket Support section) with details on how to filter messages [SPR-11952] [#16568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16568)
- No messaging module overview in the 2.2. Modules section [SPR-11847] [#16466](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16466)
- Document how to use custom `@Cacheable` annotation with AspectJ [SPR-11503] [#16128](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16128)
- Create an epub version of the Spring framework reference [SPR-11167] [#15793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15793)
- Doc: Spring MVC and the most 'specific' `@RequestMapping` URL pattern [SPR-10576] [#15205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15205)
- Explicitly mention proper URL-escaping in RestTemplate, UriTemplate, and UriComponents API Javadoc [SPR-10497] [#15130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15130)
- Documentation does not explain how `@Cacheable` and `@CacheEvict` behave in a multi-threaded environment [SPR-9588] [#14222](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14222)
- [doc] CSRF prevention support in spring form controller [SPR-6125] [#10793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10793)

:star: New Features

- AnnotationUtils should use threadsafe ConcurrentMap (contention) [SPR-12878] [#17476](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17476)
- Customize concurrency per JMS listener [SPR-11988] [#16604](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16604)
- DefaultBeanDefinitionDocumentReader should ignore the 'profile' attribute for custom namespaces [SPR-11975] [#16591](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16591)
- Add ability to check specific error on field within Spring MVC test framework [SPR-11971] [#16587](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16587)
- Support JMS 2.0's shared consumers in message listener containers [SPR-11969] [#16585](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16585)
- Add hooks in spring-messaging for Spring Security [SPR-11966] [#16582](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16582)
- Add AppCacheResourceTransformer for HTML5 offline applications [SPR-11964] [#16580](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16580)
- Ordering of MessageConverters in AbstractMessageBrokerConfiguration [SPR-11961] [#16577](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16577)
- SQLExceptionTranslators do not reliably translate QueryTimeoutException [SPR-11959] [#16575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16575)
- Reduce PlatformTransactionManager lookups in TransactionAspectSupport [SPR-11954] [#16570](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16570)
- Optimize logging at different levels with WebSocket/Messaging [SPR-11943] [#16560](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16560)
- Add support for caching destination resolver [SPR-11939] [#16556](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16556)
- Support for Types.NCLOB in SqlLobValue to simplify use with NamedParameterJdbcTemplate. [SPR-11938] [#16555](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16555)
- Support <ref> for argument-resolvers and return-value-handlers in MVC namespace [SPR-11927] [#16545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16545)
- Seamless support for Groovy bean definitions mixed with XML bean definitions [SPR-11924] [#16542](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16542)
- `@Async` Supporting ListenableFuture [SPR-11909] [#16528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16528)
- Introduce `@SqlConfig` for common SQL script configuration [SPR-11896] [#16515](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16515)
- Provide lock free access to BeanFactory methods by calling BF methods on the AbstractApplicationContext instance directly [SPR-11863] [#16482](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16482)
- ServletUriComponentsBuilder should consider X-Forwarded-Host [SPR-11855] [#16474](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16474)
- Add HTTP status code 308 Permanent Redirect [SPR-11854] [#16473](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16473)
- Add missing HandshakeInterceptor configuration to WebSocket config [SPR-11845] [#16464](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16464)
- HttpInvokerProxyFactoryBean and co do not reliably expose correct type when declared via `@Bean` [SPR-11842] [#16461](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16461)
- Support for java.util.Optional with `@Inject` (a la `@Autowired`'s required=false) [SPR-11833] [#16452](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16452)
- Support for java.util.Optional as a `@RequestParam` [SPR-11829] [#16448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16448)
- MarshallingView does not support JAXBElement value by default [SPR-11827] [#16446](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16446)
- Extend MockRestServiceServer to support AsyncRestTemplate [SPR-11822] [#16442](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16442)
- Make ListenableFuture lambda compliant [SPR-11820] [#16440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16440)
- MessageReceivingOperations returns 'null' if the payload cannot be converted [SPR-11817] [#16437](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16437)

- Refine BrokerAvailabilityEvent behavior in spring-messaging [SPR-11563] [#16187](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16187)

- MVC handler method detection should ignore scopedTarget.x in favor of corresponding proxy bean [SPR-11548] [#16173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16173)
- Optimize locking mechanism around storing flash attributes [SPR-11538] [#16163](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16163)
- relay-port type in xsd should be string [SPR-11537] [#16162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16162)
- Improve exception message for failed property access in SpEL [SPR-11535] [#16160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16160)

- Improve MockHttpServletRequest's compatibility with Servlet 3.1 [SPR-11492] [#16117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16117)
- Jaxb2RootElementHttpMessageConverter doesn't allow for customizing Marshaller/Unmarshaller [SPR-11488] [#16113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16113)
- Expose path-related request mapping settings in the MVC Java config [SPR-11486] [#16111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16111)
- String method for PatternsRequestCondition#getMatchingCondition [SPR-11484] [#16109](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16109)
- Avoid unnecessary inspection of meta-annotations on Java annotations [SPR-11483] [#16108](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16108)
- CollectionToCollectionConverter.convert() improvement for untyped collections [SPR-11479] [#16104](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16104)
- Favor more locally declared composed annotations over inherited annotations in AnnotationUtils [SPR-11475] [#16100](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16100)

- AbstractMessageConverter.supportsMimeType() should facilitate more restrictive matching strategies [SPR-11463] [#16089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16089)
- CompositeMessageConverter should allow MessageConverters to use different ContentTypeResolvers [SPR-11462] [#16088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16088)
- DefaultContentTypeResolver should support String-based "contentType" header values [SPR-11461] [#16087](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16087)
- EntityManager should explicitly get closed for non-executed Query objects [SPR-11451] [#16077](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16077)
- AnnotationUtils.findAnnotation() should support arbitrary levels of meta-annotations [SPR-11448] [#16074](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16074)
- MockMvc needs to accept prepared URI with encoded URI path variables [SPR-11441] [#16067](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16067)
- Logs fill with unnecessary stack traces when using SockJS streaming transports [SPR-11438] [#16064](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16064)
- NumberUtils.convertNumberToTargetClass does not report overflow when converting BigInteger to Long [SPR-11434] [#16060](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16060)

- Multi-message frames over STOMP. [SPR-11328] [#15952](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15952)

- Add support for default prefix in `@SendTo` and `@SendToUser` annotations [SPR-11085] [#15711](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15711)
- Allow InstrumentationSavingAgent for usage with Attach API [SPR-11083] [#15709](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15709)
- Improve process of subscribing to a user/session-specific STOMP destination [SPR-11077] [#15703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15703)
- Add BeanFactory.getBeanNamesWithAnnotation(Class<?>, boolean, boolean) for parity with getBeansOfType(...) [SPR-11069] [#15696](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15696)
- Support JCA 1.7 [SPR-11067] [#15694](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15694)
- Replace SubscribableChannel with AbstractSubscribableChannel in WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport [SPR-11065] [#15692](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15692)
- Provide XML Namespace for Configuring WebSocket and STOMP [SPR-11063] [#15690](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15690)
- Add org.springframework.cache.Cache.get(key, type) [SPR-11061] [#15688](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15688)
- Impossible to customise Hibernate RegionFactory [SPR-11056] [#15683](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15683)
- Support meta-annotation attribute overrides in the TestContext framework [SPR-11038] [#15666](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15666)
- ConfigurationClass.validate() should allow for overloading in general or not at all [SPR-11025] [#15653](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15653)
- Migrate from docbook to asciidoctor [SPR-10960] [#15588](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15588)
- `@EnableTransactionManagement` and co should also get detected on superclasses [SPR-10864] [#15491](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15491)
- Improve behavior in accidental error cases for AOP, JavaConfig and too broad pointcuts [SPR-10561] [#15191](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15191)
- Support BigDecimals with SpEL [SPR-9164] [#13802](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13802)
- Improve failure mode when depends-on cycles exist [SPR-7966] [#12621](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12621)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Fix casing in spring mvc namespace attributes "enableMatrixVariables" and "ignoreDefaultModelOnRedirect" [SPR-11136] [#15762](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15762)

- AnnotationUtils fails to retrieve attribute values from non-public annotations [SPR-11104] [#15730](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15730)
- Corrupted WebSocket messages by multi-threaded publishing to external clients [SPR-11102] [#15728](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15728)
- Connection to STOMP broker closed after a few successful messages are read [SPR-11088] [#15714](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15714)
- `@PropertySources` fails on JDK 7 due to `@Repeatable` [SPR-11086] [#15712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15712)
- Websocket connection fails with /websocket Stomp Endpoint [SPR-11058] [#15685](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15685)
- FormTag generates hidden fields from RequestDataValueProcessor.getExtraHiddenFields(...) without container, resulting in invalid xhtml [SPR-10926] [#15554](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15554)
- MockMvc can't be test under multiple threads. [SPR-10838] [#15464](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15464)
- SpEL: OpEQ should use equals() [SPR-9194] [#13832](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13832)

- Polish asciidoctor [SPR-11096] [#15722](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15722)

- `@RequestMapping` inheritance not worked as expect with a dot path [SPR-10554] [#15185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15185)
- Assign lowest priority to "/**" in AntPathMatcher [SPR-10550] [#15181](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15181)
- MarshallingHttpMessageConverter#supports() is not symmetric [SPR-10463] [#15096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15096)
- Add time zone support to the `@Scheduled` annotation for cron jobs [SPR-10456] [#15089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15089)
- UriComponentsBuilder should provide a way to remove the extension from the path [SPR-10272] [#14906](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14906)
- Allow usage of `@Lazy` on injection points [SPR-10353] [#14896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14896)
- Allow meta-annotations to override attributes from their parent [SPR-10181] [#14814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14814)
- Comprehensive support for Java 8 / OpenJDK 8 [SPR-9639] [#14273](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14273)
- Support for WebSocket messaging [SPR-9356] [#13994](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13994)

- Make org.springframework.http.MediaType Serializable [SPR-8738] [#13380](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13380)
- Doc: gzip support in RestTemplate [SPR-7874] [#12531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12531)

- HibernateTransactionManager.doBegin() is trowing NullPointerException without additional clarification [SPR-8909] [#13549](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13549)

- useDefaultSuffixPattern in RequestMappingHandlerMapping  [SPR-8898] [#13539](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13539)
- Add String constants to MediaType for use in `@RequestMapping` consumes and produces conditions [SPR-8892] [#13533](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13533)
- AspectJ `@Transactional` aspect uses runtime checks [SPR-8890] [#13531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13531)
- Allow multiple `@Filter` 'value' args for concision [SPR-8881] [#13522](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13522)
- Add methods to RequestContext to resolve URLs relative to servlet path [SPR-8863] [#13505](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13505)
- Make MethodInvokingJobDetailFactoryBean compatible with Quartz 2.x [SPR-8741] [#13383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13383)
- RestTemplate should support Void response types [SPR-8572] [#13216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13216)
- Add 'mappingLocations' to LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean to scan any JPA mapping files (ORM.xml) in the classpath. [SPR-8440] [#13086](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13086)
- 3.1.0.M2 update of the RestTemplate for Apache HTTP Components will default to sending 2 requests on authentication and doesn't support HttpContext parameters without significant extention/rewrite [SPR-8367] [#13014](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13014)
- Ability to specify ResourceResolver property for SchemaFactory in Jaxb2Marshaller [SPR-8349] [#12996](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12996)
- Allow AnnotationTypeFilter to consider interfaces as well [SPR-8336] [#12984](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12984)
- Support JSF 2.1 (JSR-314) [SPR-8102] [#12756](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12756)
- ValidationUtils: add support for Validation group interfaces [SPR-7847] [#12504](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12504)
- DefaultAnnotationHandlerMapping does not allow for distributing Portlet 2.0 action names across controllers [SPR-7685] [#12341](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12341)
- Support Java-Based Application Configuration [SPR-7420] [#12078](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12078)
- Provide alternatives to using FactoryBean types within `@Bean` methods [SPR-7418] [#12076](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12076)
- please add JMS JsonMessageConverter [SPR-7404] [#12062](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12062)
- RequestMapping header condition should apply for exact match only [SPR-7219] [#11878](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11878)
- Support for validation groups in `@Valid` used by spring MVC [SPR-6373] [#11039](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11039)
- When doing a redirect anything that is not org.springframework.beans.BeanUtils.isSimpleValueType silently gets left off of the redirect query string [SPR-5957] [#10625](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10625)
- ServletRequestDataBinder is not Extensible [SPR-5660] [#10331](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10331)
- Allow developers to introduce custom `@RequestMapping` implementations [SPR-5269] [#9942](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9942)
- Allow locations value in PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer be resolved [SPR-4902] [#9578](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9578)
- Global Errors are clumsy to bind and display in JSP [SPR-3028] [#7714](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/7714)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- org.springframework.web.WebApplicationInitializer's Javadoc missed a semi-colon; [SPR-8897] [#13538](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13538)

- RestTemplate headers not sent when bufferRequestBody is false [SPR-8809] [#13451](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13451)
- NPE when injecting `@Value` into `@Configuration` methods [SPR-8762] [#13405](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13405)
- `@Scheduled` doesn't work with well with proxies [SPR-8651] [#13293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13293)
- ContextLoaderListener overwriting config location set in WebApplicationContext [SPR-8510] [#13156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13156)
- Multiple `@CacheEvict` meta-annotated annotations not recognized [SPR-8082] [#12737](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12737)

- CollectionToCollectionConverter does not convert if the source is empty [SPR-7728] [#12384](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12384)
- ResourceHttpRequestHandler shouldn't return 404 when mime-type of existing resource can't be determined (and maybe try harder) [SPR-7713] [#12369](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12369)
- `@Transactional` with qualifier can't find PlatformTransactionManager defined in parent context [SPR-7679] [#12335](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12335)

:star: New Features

- Optimize ObjectToStringConverter to ensure copies are not made when source is already a String [SPR-7109] [#11769](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11769)

- Improve conversion system logging [SPR-7105] [#11765](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11765)

- Add ignoreJafMediaTypes to ContentNegotiatingViewResolver [SPR-7081] [#11741](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11741)
- ConversionService cannot override existing Resource editors [SPR-7079] [#11739](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11739)

- MappingJacksonJsonView.renderedAttributes to be made visible to subclasses  [SPR-7070] [#11730](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11730)
- Need the Ability to Determine if a JMS Listener has Created a Consumer for a Destination [SPR-7065] [#11725](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11725)

- Spring TestContext Framework not compatible with JUnit 4.5 [SPR-5145] [#9818](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9818)
- Add DuplicateKeyException to DAO exception hierachy [SPR-5125] [#9798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9798)
- AnnotationUtils.findAnnotation() should look for annotations on annotations [SPR-5085] [#9758](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9758)
- FreeMarkerView should support AllHttpScopesHashModel (analogous to FreeMarkerServlet in FreeMarker 2.3.14) [SPR-4962] [#9637](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9637)
- Adding hook into SQL State based exception translation [SPR-4899] [#9575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9575)
- [Performance] CachedIntrospectionResults has wrong approach to caching. [SPR-4876] [#9552](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9552)
- AnnotationMethodHandlerAdapter should treat String return type with `@ModelAttribute` as model attribute instead of view name [SPR-4867] [#9543](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9543)
- Allow annotated methods on a Controller to be marked as exception handlers [SPR-4677] [#9354](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9354)
- `@RequestMapping` methods returning null have an implicit ModelAndView created [SPR-4518] [#9195](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9195)
- When using request mappings at the type-level like /hotels/*, it should be possible to define a controller handler method for the root like /hotels [SPR-4494] [#9172](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9172)
- `@Autowired` dependencies and external configuration [SPR-4447] [#9125](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9125)
- Comprehensive REST Support [SPR-4419] [#9097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9097)
- org.springframework.jdbc.object.StoredProcedure is an abstract class, although it may be allowed to be used as a concrete class after the jira change SPR-3898 [SPR-3987] [#8667](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8667)
- Provide a concrete implementation of MappingSqlQuery (say RowMappingSqlQuery) which can be injected a RowMapper, so that we can put it in a config file [SPR-3986] [#8666](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8666)
- Enable custom default value for `@Transactional`'s rollbackFor argument [SPR-3027] [#7713](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/7713)
- Subclass DataIntegrityViolationException to represent main constraint types and translate SQL exceptons into appropriate subclass [SPR-2977] [#7663](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/7663)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- AopUtils.getTargetClass assumes cglib proxies are always proxying classes [SPR-5694] [#10364](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10364)
- ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.isConfigurationClassBeanDefinition() makes classloading assumptions that don't hold true in an OSGi environment [SPR-5693] [#10363](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10363)
- SPR-5668 introduced occasional ConcurrentModificationException in callees of AspectJExpressionPointcut.getShadowMatch() [SPR-5687] [#10357](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10357)
- template.mf contains invalid range for org.hibernate.ejb [SPR-5685] [#10346](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10346)
- Spring 3 library omits org.springframework.expression [SPR-5675] [#10345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10345)
- SPEL: Projections don't work within templates (ParseException) [SPR-5673] [#10344](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10344)
- SPEL: Inconsistent implementation of ReflectivePropertyResolver - canRead vs. read for null targets [SPR-5663] [#10334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10334)
- SPEL: NullPointerException when passing null values as parameters to method calls [SPR-5661] [#10332](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10332)
- Race condition in AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor.AutowiredMethodElement.inject()? [SPR-5658] [#10329](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10329)
- RestTemplate handles redirects incorrectly [SPR-5653] [#10324](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10324)
- Incorrect .classpath file for org.springframework.context [SPR-5645] [#10316](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10316)
- ASM bundle contains an import package for org.objectweb.asm [SPR-5618] [#10289](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10289)
- Optional Ivy dependencies are mandatory in the OXM bundle's manifest [SPR-5617] [#10288](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10288)
- Spring library does not include the ASM and OXM bundles [SPR-5616] [#10287](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10287)
- Regression: InterfaceBasedMBeanInfoAssembler setManagedInterfaces fails if interfaces are passed in [SPR-5615] [#10286](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10286)
- NPE in AbstractCachingLabeledEnumResolver.getLabeledEnumByLabel following garbage collection [SPR-5577] [#10248](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10248)
- typo in RestTemplate javadoc [SPR-5571] [#10243](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10243)
- ASM based SimpleMetadataReader returns also annotations on members [SPR-5545] [#10216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10216)
- ReSTful URLs with content type extension do not work properly [SPR-5537] [#10208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10208)
- RestTemplate does not do HTTP GET if it should [SPR-5536] [#10207](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10207)
- PermGen leak in GenericTypeResolver's typeVariableCache [SPR-5462] [#10135](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10135)
- All maven2 artifactIds change (will break a lot of builds for maven users) [SPR-5385] [#10058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10058)
- Race-Condition in RMIServiceExporter [SPR-5263] [#9893](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9893)

:star: New Features

- Improvement to ConstructorResolver [SPR-5522] [#10193](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10193)
- Spring expression: please improve getValue() in CompositeStringExpression [SPR-5466] [#10139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10139)
- Add AtomView sample to PetClinic [SPR-5460] [#10133](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10133)
- Spring expression: ReflectionUtils don't respect boolean getters starting with 'is' [SPR-5450] [#10123](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10123)
- ReflectionUtils.findMethod does not find methods for Object.class [SPR-5434] [#10108](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10108)
- RequestParam can't properly parse an optional boolean parameter [SPR-5410] [#10083](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10083)
- TypeUtils.isAssignable should return true for ParametrizedType assignable to Object [SPR-5390] [#10063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10063)
- MarshallingView should override AbstractView instead of AbstractUrlBasedView [SPR-5380] [#10053](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10053)
- Collection type resolver considering only lower bound of wildcard [SPR-5344] [#10017](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10017)
- ExecutorCompletionService for Spring TaskExecutor [SPR-5341] [#10014](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10014)
- Rationalise ThreadPoolTaskExecutor and ScheduledExecutorFactoryBean [SPR-5337] [#10010](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10010)
- HibernateClinic in PetClinic sample should use constructor-injection instead of field injection [SPR-5326] [#9999](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9999)
- AOP PointCuts: ProceedingJointPoint provides the synthetic(bridge) and not the real method [SPR-5317] [#9990](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9990)
- PropertyValue does not copy the converted semantics of a given pv [SPR-5293] [#9966](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9966)
- Migrate OXM from Spring-WS to Spring Core [SPR-5259] [#9933](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9933)
- Prototype application context event listeners are not notified within the events [SPR-5248] [#9922](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9922)
- Prototype beans that implement ApplicationListener shouldn't be created during container initialization [SPR-5247] [#9921](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9921)
- ApplicationListener notifications to reflect Ordered interface [SPR-5240] [#9914](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9914)
- util:constant can't read static inner enums [SPR-5210] [#9883](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9883)
- #springUrl does not run encodeURL() [SPR-5134] [#9807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9807)
- Genericize ApplicationListener [SPR-4610] [#9287](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9287)
- Portlet 2.0 (JSR 286) support in Spring MVC [SPR-4259] [#8937](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8937)
- ApplicationListener beans eagerly instantiated even when marked as lazy-init [SPR-4054] [#8733](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8733)
- Asynchronous execution of ApplicationListeners through annotation [SPR-3876] [#8556](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8556)
- AsynchronousExecutionInterceptor [SPR-3528] [#8211](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8211)
- Nicer handling of Java 5 enums by the Spring MVC form taglib. [SPR-3389] [#8072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8072)
- util:property-path like functionality for the p-namespace [SPR-3360] [#8044](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8044)
- Add JDK 5 Generics support to HibernateTemplate's returned Lists [SPR-3128] [#7814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/7814)
- Improvement for handling checkboxes in web forms (patch included) [SPR-2733] [#7421](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/7421)
- Provide out of the box implementation of the thread scope [SPR-2581] [#7270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/7270)
- ApplicationEventMulticaster should efficiently dispatch according to event type and source [SPR-2572] [#7261](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/7261)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- RestTemplate should encode the url variables [SPR-5516] [#10187](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10187)
- NPE when passing null as a request to RestTemplate.postForLocation [SPR-5515] [#10186](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10186)
- Buggy reuse of list in prototype, when using shorthand definition in xml. [SPR-5512] [#10184](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10184)
- ModelAndView.getModel method garbages wasCleared state [SPR-5505] [#10177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10177)
- Alias chaining does not work with `@Qualifier` and `@Autowired` [SPR-5501] [#10173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10173)
- Error in javadoc for org.springframework.web.portlet.mvc.AbstractFormController [SPR-5478] [#10151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10151)
- AnnotationMetadataReadingVisitor doesn't consider annotation method returning classes [SPR-5477] [#10150](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10150)
- Multi-dimensional array brakes HTTP invokers remoting [SPR-5473] [#10146](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10146)
- Possible NPE in JmsUtils.buildExceptionMessage and JmsException.getMessage [SPR-5470] [#10143](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10143)
- Spring expression: NPE in org.springframework.expression.spel.ast.Ternary [SPR-5441] [#10115](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10115)
- grammatical error in LobHandler javadoc [SPR-5440] [#10114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10114)
- org.springframework.expression: Bug in TemplateAwareExpressionParser when expressionString contains '}' [SPR-5438] [#10112](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10112)
- JoinPoint and Singature toString, toShortString, and toLongString don't return useful information [SPR-5437] [#10111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10111)
- `@RequestMapping` type-level params not taken into account consistently [SPR-5421] [#10095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10095)
- Infinite loop in bean creation when placeholder used for bean name [SPR-5419] [#10093](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10093)
- BridgeMethodResolver is unable to locate bridged method for hibernate Cglib-wrapped class implementing a generic interface [SPR-5414] [#10088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10088)
- SpringBeanAutowiringInterceptor.autowireBean() has wrong signature [SPR-5412] [#10085](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10085)
- DefaultLobHandler should honour "wrapAsLob" for getting data too [SPR-5376] [#10049](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10049)
- SPEL PropertyOrFieldReference not threadsafe [SPR-5374] [#10047](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10047)
- `@Qualifier` no longer works in 3.0 [SPR-5355] [#10028](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10028)
- AbstractResource.exists() doesn't close connection correctly on a not found http url [SPR-5338] [#10011](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10011)
- manager.sh classpath for petclinic should be updated (patch included) [SPR-5335] [#10008](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10008)
- PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer always tries to replace maps due to incorrect modification check in BeanDefinitionVisitor [SPR-5318] [#9991](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9991)
- StackOverflowError when using MessageListenerAdapter without delegate [SPR-5309] [#9982](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9982)
- spring-test-2.5.6.jar incompatible with junit distribution from SpringSource Enterprise Bundle Repository [SPR-5291] [#9964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9964)
- spring-context manifest import-package of javax.annotation;version="[1.  0.0, 2.0.0)" conflicts with provided system bundle javax.annotation; version="0.0.0" [SPR-5290] [#9963](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9963)
- WebsphereUowTransactionManager and UOWManager wrap checked exceptions if declared to roll back [SPR-5270] [#9943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9943)
- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver(ClassLoader classLoader) [SPR-5264] [#9937](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9937)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Update Pet Clinic to use HSQL as an embedded database [SPR-5429] [#10103](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10103)

- Exception cache resolver shouldn't be mandatory [SPR-12850] [#17448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17448)

:star: New Features

- Improve Reference Documentation about Spring JMS (infrastructure) [SPR-12073] [#16689](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16689)
- Make `@Payload` as ElementType.METHOD too [SPR-12071] [#16687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16687)
- Consider adding static notFound() builder method to ResponseEntity [SPR-12070] [#16686](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16686)
- JmsMessagingExceptionTranslator package tangle [SPR-12064] [#16680](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16680)
- Add more HttpHeaders constants for standard HTTP headers [SPR-12063] [#16679](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16679)
- Improve exception message: Default SmartContextLoaders do not support locations and `@Configuration` classes simultaneously [SPR-12060] [#16676](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16676)
- Shortcut method for building HEAD requests with MockMvcRequestBuilders [SPR-12055] [#16671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16671)
- Introduce `@TestPropertySource` support in the TestContext framework [SPR-12051] [#16667](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16667)
- String to Enum Interface conversion not working [SPR-12050] [#16666](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16666)
- Missing custom entity type filter in LocalSessionFactoryBean [SPR-12049] [#16665](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16665)
- Improve comment in RuntimeTestWalker [SPR-12044] [#16660](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16660)
- Document that MockHttpServletRequest does not comply with Servlet spec regarding Accept-Language header [SPR-12043] [#16659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16659)
- SpEL Compiler: Make OpModulus compilable  [SPR-12041] [#16657](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16657)
- JmsListener/ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor should use SmartInitializingSingleton instead of ContextRefreshedEvent [SPR-12039] [#16655](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16655)
- JmsMessagingTemplate should not throw JmsException directly [SPR-12038] [#16654](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16654)
- Update JmsMessagingTemplate to support MessageRequestReplyOperations [SPR-12037] [#16653](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16653)
- Enhance ResourceHandlerRegistration API for resource transformers/resolvers [SPR-11982] [#16598](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16598)
- Isolation support for JPA with Hibernate EntityManager 4 [SPR-11942] [#16559](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16559)
- Provide initial support for Undertow 1.1 [SPR-11914] [#16533](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16533)
- Support Jackson2 based XML serialization/deserialization [SPR-11785] [#16407](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16407)
- `@Configuration` imported via `@ImportResource` is not processed [SPR-11723] [#16345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16345)
- Introduce mechanism for automatic discovery of default TestExecutionListeners [SPR-11466] [#16092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16092)
- `@Configuration` imported via ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar is not processed as configuration [SPR-11430] [#16056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16056)
- Support for JSR-356 on WebLogic 12.1.3 [SPR-11293] [#15917](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15917)
- BeanFactory lacks method for getting bean by type with specified constructor arguments [SPR-11235] [#15860](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15860)
- Support Groovy scripts for bean definitions in the TestContext framework [SPR-11233] [#15858](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15858)
- Compatibility with GlassFish 4.1 and Tyrus 1.8 (WebSocket 1.1) [SPR-11094] [#15720](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15720)
- `@ComponentScan` does not allow for registering beans with lazy initialization [SPR-10459] [#15092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15092)
- Spel Implicit Map [SPR-9472] [#14107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14107)
- Hibernate4 version of SpringSessionContext.currentSession() does not create a session if TransactionSynchronizationManager does not contain one [SPR-9020] [#13659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13659)
- readOnly transaction doesn't work with JPA and Hibernate 4 [SPR-8959] [#13599](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13599)
- Introduce mechanism for registering default TELs if a custom TEL is registered via `@TestExecutionListeners` [SPR-8854] [#13496](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13496)
- UrlBasedViewResolver should implement setExposedContextBeanNames (not InternalResourceViewResolver) [SPR-8064] [#12719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12719)
- Passing lookup-method arguments to created bean constructor [SPR-7431] [#12089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12089)
- Spring REST `@MVC`: Add support for google Protocol Buffers resource representation format [SPR-5807] [#10477](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10477)
- `@LookupMethod` annotation for use with component scanning [SPR-5192] [#9865](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9865)
- Binding in Velocity templates using EL accessors ([, ]) for collections produces non xhtml strict compliant output [SPR-5172] [#9845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9845)
- HibernateJpaDialect does not support setting a specific isolation level per transaction [SPR-5012] [#9687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9687)
- How to implement Pessimistic Locking with JPA [SPR-3812] [#8492](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8492)
- Implement synchronous request / response logic in JmsTemplate [SPR-3332] [#8017](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/8017)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- SpEL Compiler: NPE on Indexer compilation, when is used map accessor [SPR-12045] [#16661](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16661)
- SpEL Compiler produces incompatible code with method generic returns [SPR-12040] [#16656](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16656)
- SockJsClient doesn't propagate "subProtocols" and "extensions" to the handshake request [SPR-12030] [#16646](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16646)
- NPE in DefaultListableBeanFactory#getPriority [SPR-12024] [#16640](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16640)
- Restore method signature for ViewControllerRegistration.setViewName [SPR-12016] [#16632](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16632)
- NPE in Elvis Expression (ExitTypeDescriptor null) [SPR-12014] [#16630](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16630)
- ThymeleafViewResolver not used by Spring 4.1 resulting in "circular view path" error [SPR-12013] [#16629](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16629)
- Spring 4.1 schema issues [SPR-12011] [#16627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16627)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Update references to RFC 2616 [SPR-12067] [#16683](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16683)
- Improve documentation for using "." vs "/" as separators with STOMP/WebSocket messaging [SPR-12007] [#16623](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16623)
- Add documentation for Java SockJS client  [SPR-12006] [#16622](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16622)
- Enrich Spring reference documentation (Websocket Support section) with details on how to filter messages [SPR-11952] [#16568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16568)
- No messaging module overview in the 2.2. Modules section [SPR-11847] [#16466](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16466)
- Document how to use custom `@Cacheable` annotation with AspectJ [SPR-11503] [#16128](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16128)
- Create an epub version of the Spring framework reference [SPR-11167] [#15793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15793)
- Doc: Spring MVC and the most 'specific' `@RequestMapping` URL pattern [SPR-10576] [#15205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15205)
- Explicitly mention proper URL-escaping in RestTemplate, UriTemplate, and UriComponents API Javadoc [SPR-10497] [#15130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15130)
- Documentation does not explain how `@Cacheable` and `@CacheEvict` behave in a multi-threaded environment [SPR-9588] [#14222](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14222)
- [doc] CSRF prevention support in spring form controller [SPR-6125] [#10793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10793)

- AnnotationUtils should use threadsafe ConcurrentMap (contention) [SPR-12878] [#17476](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17476)

- DefaultBeanDefinitionDocumentReader should ignore the 'profile' attribute for custom namespaces [SPR-11975] [#16591](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16591)
- Add ability to check specific error on field within Spring MVC test framework [SPR-11971] [#16587](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16587)
- Support JMS 2.0's shared consumers in message listener containers [SPR-11969] [#16585](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16585)
- Add hooks in spring-messaging for Spring Security [SPR-11966] [#16582](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16582)
- Add AppCacheResourceTransformer for HTML5 offline applications [SPR-11964] [#16580](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16580)
- Ordering of MessageConverters in AbstractMessageBrokerConfiguration [SPR-11961] [#16577](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16577)
- SQLExceptionTranslators do not reliably translate QueryTimeoutException [SPR-11959] [#16575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16575)
- Reduce PlatformTransactionManager lookups in TransactionAspectSupport [SPR-11954] [#16570](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16570)
- Optimize logging at different levels with WebSocket/Messaging [SPR-11943] [#16560](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16560)
- Add support for caching destination resolver [SPR-11939] [#16556](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16556)
- Support for Types.NCLOB in SqlLobValue to simplify use with NamedParameterJdbcTemplate. [SPR-11938] [#16555](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16555)
- Support <ref> for argument-resolvers and return-value-handlers in MVC namespace [SPR-11927] [#16545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16545)
