- `@Async` Supporting ListenableFuture [SPR-11909] [#16528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16528)
- Introduce `@SqlConfig` for common SQL script configuration [SPR-11896] [#16515](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16515)
- Provide lock free access to BeanFactory methods by calling BF methods on the AbstractApplicationContext instance directly [SPR-11863] [#16482](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16482)
- ServletUriComponentsBuilder should consider X-Forwarded-Host [SPR-11855] [#16474](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16474)
- Add HTTP status code 308 Permanent Redirect [SPR-11854] [#16473](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16473)
- Add missing HandshakeInterceptor configuration to WebSocket config [SPR-11845] [#16464](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16464)
- HttpInvokerProxyFactoryBean and co do not reliably expose correct type when declared via `@Bean` [SPR-11842] [#16461](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16461)
- Support for java.util.Optional with `@Inject` (a la `@Autowired`'s required=false) [SPR-11833] [#16452](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16452)
- Support for java.util.Optional as a `@RequestParam` [SPR-11829] [#16448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16448)
- MarshallingView does not support JAXBElement value by default [SPR-11827] [#16446](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16446)
- Extend MockRestServiceServer to support AsyncRestTemplate [SPR-11822] [#16442](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16442)
- Make ListenableFuture lambda compliant [SPR-11820] [#16440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16440)
- MessageReceivingOperations returns 'null' if the payload cannot be converted [SPR-11817] [#16437](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16437)
- Create a common interface for AnnotationConfigApplicationContext and AnnotationConfigWebApplicationContext [SPR-11814] [#16434](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16434)
- Add events for subscribe/unsubscribe stomp commands [SPR-11813] [#16433](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16433)
- Enhance ResourceHttpRequestHandler with ResourceTransformer strategy [SPR-11800] [#16420](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16420)
- Expose current HttpServletResponse for autowiring [SPR-11795] [#16416](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16416)
- Support Groovy markup templating in Spring MVC [SPR-11789] [#16411](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16411)
- Support org.springframework.messaging.Message as an alternative to MessageCreator in the JMS support [SPR-11772] [#16394](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16394)
- Allow configuration of path mapping options for websocket handler mapping (e.g. alwaysUseFullPath) [SPR-11771] [#16393](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16393)
- Add SQL error code mapping for SAP HANA database [SPR-11770] [#16392](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16392)
- `@ComponentScan` should get processed without `@Configuration` as well [SPR-11769] [#16391](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16391)
- Move Spring Boot's YAML properties into the core framework. [SPR-11767] [#16389](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16389)
- MockHttpServletRequest should not require setContent for non-null getInputStream() result [SPR-11764] [#16386](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16386)
- Path matching options in MVC Java/XML config should apply to all handler mappings [SPR-11753] [#16375](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16375)
- Provide builders for HttpEntity and ResponseEntity [SPR-11752] [#16374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16374)
- Make constants in HttpHeaders public [SPR-11749] [#16371](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16371)
- Improve reconnect attemps option in DefaultMessageListenerContainer [SPR-11746] [#16368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16368)
- Expose STOMP/WebSocket monitoring info and internal stats [SPR-11739] [#16361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16361)
- Skip Java immutable objects in session when processing the accessed attributes [SPR-11738] [#16360](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16360)
- Cacheable javadoc wrongly explains how cache keys are generated [SPR-11736] [#16358](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16358)
- Auto-proxy creation should not consider GroovyObject as a user-specified interface [SPR-11715] [#16337](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16337)
- Introduce isAnnotation() in ClassMetadata API [SPR-11711] [#16333](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16333)

:star: New Features

- Can `@Profile` be `@Documented` [SPR-10967] [#15595](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15595)
- Add support for sending Ping and Pong WebSocket messages as well as for handling incoming Pong messages [SPR-10876] [#15503](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15503)
- Implement ChannelInterceptor-like feature for SockJS/WebSocket/STOMP messages [SPR-10866] [#15493](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15493)
- Add client and server-side WebSocket container configuration support  [SPR-10844] [#15471](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15471)
- MockMvcBuilders.standaloneSetup() ignores controller path mapping URIs' placeholders [SPR-10825] [#15451](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15451)
- Untranslated Hibernate exception [SPR-10815] [#15441](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15441)

- Stereotype `@Profiles` not merged [SPR-10812] [#15438](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15438)
- Make it possible to configure serialization inclusion for Jackson ObjectMapper [SPR-10810] [#15436](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15436)
- Make the use of JSON library in the SockJS service configurable [SPR-10800] [#15426](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15426)
- Add support for discovering JPA 2.1 `@Converter` during scanning [SPR-10799] [#15425](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15425)
- Allow headers to be set on WebSocketConnectionManager [SPR-10796] [#15422](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15422)
- Add LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean missing methods to easily replace elements in persistence.xml [SPR-10764] [#15390](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15390)
- Request streaming for HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory [SPR-10728] [#15356](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15356)
- Add recovery-interval to <jms:listener-container> [SPR-10711] [#15339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15339)
- Make UriComponents.UriTemplateVariables public [SPR-10647] [#15275](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15275)
- Allow BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor to register other BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessors [SPR-10630] [#15258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15258)
- Provide access to attributes from the handshake HTTP session [SPR-10624] [#15252](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15252)
- Allow `@Bean` to override a dynamically registered bean definition [SPR-10607] [#15236](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15236)
- New `@Description` annotation to add description field to BeanDefinition when using annotation based configuration [SPR-10583] [#15212](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15212)
- `@RequestMapping` inheritance not worked as expect with a dot path [SPR-10554] [#15185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15185)
- Assign lowest priority to "/**" in AntPathMatcher [SPR-10550] [#15181](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15181)
- MarshallingHttpMessageConverter#supports() is not symmetric [SPR-10463] [#15096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15096)
- Add time zone support to the `@Scheduled` annotation for cron jobs [SPR-10456] [#15089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15089)
- UriComponentsBuilder should provide a way to remove the extension from the path [SPR-10272] [#14906](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14906)
- Allow usage of `@Lazy` on injection points [SPR-10353] [#14896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14896)
- Allow meta-annotations to override attributes from their parent [SPR-10181] [#14814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14814)
- Comprehensive support for Java 8 / OpenJDK 8 [SPR-9639] [#14273](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14273)
- Support for WebSocket messaging [SPR-9356] [#13994](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13994)
- Support an asynchronous API for RestTemplate [SPR-8804] [#13446](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13446)
- Make org.springframework.http.MediaType Serializable [SPR-8738] [#13380](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13380)
- Doc: gzip support in RestTemplate [SPR-7874] [#12531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12531)
- Autowiring should support ordered collection driven by Order annotation or Ordered interface [SPR-5574] [#10245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10245)

- Stomp passcode should not be included in plain text in log messages [SPR-10868] [#15495](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15495)
